title: Trace and canonical generation for rational surface singularities
statement: Let $(A,\mathfrak m)$ be a commutative Noetherian normal Nagata local domain of dimension $2$ defining a rational singularity [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring], [def-weil-pbc-nagata-ring], [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring], [def-per-rational-surface-singularity]. Fix a normalized algebraic dualizing complex $\Omega_A$ [def-per-algebraic-normalized-dualizing]. For a normal modification $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ (proper, integral normal source and an isomorphism on function fields, as in [def-per-rational-surface-singularity]) put $\omega_A=H^{-2}(\Omega_A)$ and $\omega_X=H^{-2}(f^!\widetilde\Omega_A)$, where $f^!$ is the right adjoint of derived pushforward on the derived categories with quasi-coherent cohomology [def-pc-derived-category]; by [lem-per-normal-surface-canonical-module], $\Omega_A\cong\omega_A[2]$ and $f^!\widetilde\Omega_A\cong\omega_X[2]$. Then the duality trace (degree $-2$ global sections of the counit $Rf_*f^!\widetilde\Omega_A\to\widetilde\Omega_A$) is an isomorphism $\Gamma(X,\omega_X)\xrightarrow{\sim}\omega_A$. Its inverse followed by evaluation of global sections defines a morphism $\alpha_f:f^*\widetilde\omega_A\to\omega_X$ [def-pc-module-pullback]. (i) If $A$ is not regular and $f$ is its ordinary maximal-ideal blowup [def-weil-regular-scheme], [def-nagata-global-blowup], then $\alpha_f$ is surjective. (ii) If $f$ is an isomorphism, $\alpha_f$ is an isomorphism. (iii) Let $g:X'\to X$ be a proper morphism with $f'=f\circ g$ also a normal modification, let $x\in X$ be closed with $B=\mathcal O_{X,x}$ of dimension $2$, Nagata and defining a rational singularity, and let $g_B:X'_B\to\operatorname{Spec}B$ be as in clause (b) of [lem-per-normal-surface-canonical-module], with $\Omega_B=\omega_{X,x}[2]$. Then, under the identifications of that clause, the restriction of $\alpha_{f'}$ to $X'_B$ equals the composite of $g_B^*$ of the restriction of $\alpha_f$ to $\operatorname{Spec}B$ with $\alpha_{g_B}:g_B^*\widetilde\omega_B\to\omega_{X'_B}$.

source.place: Tags 0BBU (lemma-dualizing-rational) and 0B64 (lemma-dualizing-blow-up-rational), conclusion (3). Localization and composition refer to duality.tex section-trace: trace is the counit of the right adjoint, and its base-change lemma. Clause (iii): the trace of a composite is the composite of traces (duality.tex section-trace, counit of the composite right adjoint, Tag 0ATX) and trace commutes with flat base change (Tag 0B6J, lemma-trace-map-and-base-change).

from.place: Technical surface-resolution input to dimension-normalized Verdier duality in lem-per-artin-gabber-affine-curve, proof Step 1; via the potential-dualizing construction and ILO XVII 3.4.1. Realizes the Tag 0BBV, resolve-lemma-rational-to-gorenstein, specialized using dualizing.tex Tag 0BFR (dualizing-lemma-ubiquity-dualizing), clauses (2),(5). Normal surfaces are Cohen-Macaulay by properties.tex Tag 0B3D, and an invertible dualizing sheaf gives Gorenstein local rings by duality.tex Tag 0AWW (duality-definition-gorenstein). input in the proof of Stacks 0BGN. Specific supporting input: 0BBV second paragraph: surjectivity along the singular-point chain, with localization and the generic normalization of the canonical maps.
